identity.en: A ghostly gaunt young Chinese woman in her twenties, drenched and dripping, contemporary urban China
identity.text: 26 岁中国女性，苏晚在循环里的自己，浑身湿透、滴着水

face.en: Thin gaunt face with sunken dark eye sockets, pale skin with a cold bluish undertone, chapped split lips, a faint needle mark on one cheek, eyes open but glassy and empty with a wet glint, slightly asymmetrical eyelids and brows; face partly hidden behind wet hair and shadow in its default state, head hanging low
face.text: 脸瘦、眼窝深陷发青，皮肤苍白泛青像在水里泡过，嘴唇干裂起皮，脸颊一枚细小针眼，眼睛睁着却空洞湿润；常态垂着头，脸被湿发与阴影盖住

hair.en: Long black wet hair plastered in thick strands against her cheeks and neck, dripping water from the tips
hair.text: 黑色长发湿透，一缕缕贴在脸颊与脖颈，发梢往下滴水

outfit.label: 常态 · 湿透青白衬衫

top.en: an old washed-out blue-white shirt with a frayed collar and a yellowed patch on one sleeve, the hem sodden and darkened where it touches the floor
top.text: 很旧的青白衬衫，领口磨毛，一只袖口有块洗不掉的黄，下摆湿透洇深贴地

bottom.en: the old shirt hanging past her knees over bare legs, a small pool of water gathering at her feet
bottom.text: 衬衫下摆垂到膝下，赤脚，脚下积着一小滩水

details.en: a single wet hair tip with a hanging drop of water
details.text: 发梢悬着一滴将落的水

details.en: the frayed collar of the old washed-out blue-white shirt
the yellowed patch on one sleeve of the old washed-out blue-white shirt
details.text: 袖口那块洗不掉的黄渍

details.en: bare feet standing in a small pool of water
